                Sue's Notes:


                         Cedar Hill Studio original Sapphire blue recipe. This isn't my glaze recipe, it has been
                         used at the studio for years. We keep the Specific Gravity around 1.5 and flocculate.


                             This glaze showed no visible signs of leaching/discolouration when when tested with
                                                                                            Cone 6 oxidation, Plainsman M340
                         lemon juice and vinegar.
